deadline.value: The Fall semester deadline is December 15, so Fall 2027 applications close December 15, 2026.

gre_general.value: The department requires no standardized test.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

fee_waiver.value: The department and the university do not offer application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: fee waivers are not available at the department or university level

english_waiver.value: The department does not waive English proficiency, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: The CS department does not waive English Proficiency Requirements.

funding.value: Most admitted PhD students are fully funded, mainly through research or teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: Most admitted PhD students are fully funded.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by a faculty committee, and a temporary advisor is assigned after admission.
supervisor.quote: Admissions decisions are made by a committee of CS faculty

entry_route.value: Applicants who hold a BS or an MS may apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who hold (or will soon receive) a BS or MS may apply to the PhD program.

notes: The page lists a PhD GPA minimum of 3.5 on a 4-point scale.
